node.statement: Hypothesis bridge and Munkres application: let M be an arbitrary compact smooth manifold without boundary. Smooth means C-infinity, hence in particular C^1, and the shard scope note identifies without boundary with the non-bounded case in GT-munkres-edt-thm-10.6. Instantiating GT-munkres-edt-thm-10.6 at r=1 therefore yields a simplicial complex K and a C^1 triangulation f: |K| -> M.
